# Al Bakir Pvt Ltd

> Design, construction and real estate company based in Multi Gardens B-17, Islamabad, Pakistan. Integrated architecture, construction, engineering, interior design and real estate services delivered by a single accountable team, from concept to handover.

Al Bakir has delivered 50+ projects and holds a 4.8 Google rating. Open 24 hours daily except Friday.

## Services

- Architecture & Design: bespoke residential and commercial design rooted in context, climate and craft.
- Construction: end-to-end build delivery with disciplined timelines and material integrity.
- Real Estate: curated property opportunities across B-17 Islamabad and surrounding sectors, including sales, rentals and investment.
